preconditions.description: The input word consists of 1 to 100 Latin letters (uppercase or lowercase).
The input word contains only alphabetic characters (no digits, symbols, or whitespace).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == stdin.strip().lower() if sum(1 for c in stdin.strip() if c.isupper()) <= sum(1 for c in stdin.strip() if c.islower()) else stdin.strip().upper()
postconditions.description: The output word is the input word converted to lowercase if the number of uppercase letters is less than or equal to the number of lowercase letters; otherwise, it is converted to uppercase.
